soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.54–0.58, lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly narrowed behind the antennal sockets, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal peaks slightly raised. Labrum lanceolate, apex narrow and rounded, apical setae present, subapical setae very small, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles short and stout, apex short, pointed and strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; mandible length 0.47–0.52 times head capsule length and 0.87–0.91 times head width. Antennae 17–18 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist index 0.30–0.35. Pronotum trapezoidal, 1.6–1.7 times as wide as long, anterior margin with a broad forked shallow concavity, posterior margin very shallowly incised; about 30 setae in the middle region.
